item.title: Accused killer from El Salvador caught after crash in Lee County, deputies say
item.description: An international gang member wanted for homicide in El Salvador was captured in Lee County following a crash Wednesday, deputies said.

item.title: Man hospitalized after shooting on School Street in Fayetteville, police say
item.description: A shooting in Fayetteville Thursday afternoon sent a man to the hospital, police said.

item.title: Video shows suspect arrested at gunpoint in Moore County double killing
item.description: Ohio state troopers on Thursday released video of the weekend arrest of a man accused of killing his former girlfriend, a Ukrainian refugee, and a Fort Bragg soldier at a Woodlake home in Moore County on Valentine's Day.

item.title: 2 teens arrested after boy killed in Durham gas station shooting: Police
item.description: Two teenagers were arrested Thursday in connection with a deadly shooting in Durham earlier this week that took the life of a juvenile, police said.

item.title: Police investigate 'suspicious death' at site of former W.L. Greene Alternative School in Nashville
item.description: According to the Nashville Police Department, investigators are at the former site of W.L. Greene Alternative School regarding a suspicious death. The police chief said officers were on a proactive patrol of the area when they found the person.

item.title: Record heat and rain ahead of cold front for central NC
item.description: Despite cloudy skies and chances for rain, high temperatures are expected to flirt with record highs before a weekend cold front. Friday will be the warmest day of the week, as well as the month! The forecast high for Friday is 75 degrees, which would tie the record of 75 degrees set back in 1939. [...]

item.title: Neighbors jump into action to save Wilson County mobile home community from fire
item.description: Neighbors in rural Wilson County say quick thinking and resourcefulness likely saved their mobile home community from going up in flames.

item.title: Juvenile found with a stab wound on North Raleigh Boulevard, police say
item.description: A juvenile was taken the hospital Thursday night with a stab wound, according to police.

item.description: Multiple Raleigh police units are responding to an apartment complex in north Raleigh Thursday night.
